name: My name is...
source:
The pilot is determined to crash the plane and send the crew and passengers to their deaths. You are the newest rescue AI, tasked with stopping the pilot by any means necessary.

[Translated from [url=https://t05ka.itch.io/my-name-is]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
飞行员铁了心要让飞机坠毁，带全体机组人员和乘客共赴黄泉。你是最新型的救援AI，任务是不惜一切代价阻止他。
